correctness.rationale: Independent parent choices imply exact leaf survival probabilities and a conditional attachment-to-leaf effect. Summing its covariances gives the displayed harmonic formula for every allowed n and i. Strict convexity is an exact positive second difference; n=7 onset and the limiting root of (1-t)/2+t log t are analytically established. Exhaustive rational enumeration n<=8 and 11,429 checker assertions corroborate critical steps but are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Vertex birth rank and total terminal-vertex count are intrinsic complementary observables of recursive-tree growth. The work identifies the exact local source of positive and negative influence, completely classifies the nonroot covariance signs for every tree size, and proves a universal macroscopic transition at an explicit transcendental root, instead of merely recomputing means or isolated small cases.
